generatedProse.practice-connection:
You now have a way of planning your revision that will serve you in every module from here on. Each exam you meet is a test of what you understand, each weak topic a pointer to where your time should go, and active practice is how the two come together. The habit to keep is simple: plan your time against your gaps, choose active recall over re-reading, and match each technique to the material in front of you.

That same habit carries beyond your studies. Wherever you have to learn a lot in a limited time, the people who improve are the ones who work where they are weakest and practise producing what they know. The strategy you have just learned to build is one you will use long after you graduate.
